# Web Hacking

A curated list of web hacking tools and learning resources.

## Tools

- [HeaderFuzzer](https://example.test/headerfuzzer) - Fuzzes HTTP headers to find injection points and misconfigurations.
- [SSRF Scout](https://example.test/ssrf-scout) - Server-side request forgery probes against internal metadata endpoints.
- **[JWT Forge](https://example.test/jwt-forge)** - Forges and mutates JSON Web Token claims for session testing.
- [TemplateProbe](https://example.test/templateprobe)
- [IDOR Mapper](https://example.test/idor-mapper) - Maps object references to expose insecure direct object access across accounts.
- A printed field guide to browser security, available from the community bookshelf.
- [SSRF Scout Mirror](https://example.test/ssrf-scout/) - Mirror listing of the SSRF Scout entry above.
- [BrokenBracket](https://example.test/broken-bracket - This entry is missing its closing parenthesis.
- [QuoteSneak](https://example.test/quote-sneak) - Notes on queries containing " OR * NEAR( as literal text, never syntax.

## Learning Resources

- [DOM Clobbering Notes](https://example.test/dom-clobbering-notes) - Writeups on DOM clobbering and client-side prototype pollution.
- [Cache Poison Diaries](https://example.test/cache-poison-diaries) - Case studies of web cache poisoning in the wild.
